o1: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in collagen biosynthetic process; regulation of gene expression; regulation of nematode larval development; and egg-laying. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including R2_hyp; gonad; hypodermis; neurons; and proctodeal cell. Orthologous to human ZNF362 (zinc finger protein 362).
